jobs.description:
ABOUT ZOLVE
Welcome to the financial frontier of limitless possibilities - welcome to Zolve. We're not just a fintech; we're architects of a financial revolution, crafting a narrative that transcends borders. At Zolve, we believe in rewriting the rules of finance to empower global citizens, nomads, and dreamers to navigate the world without constraints.
Zolve is the world's first cross border neo-bank which helps migrants get access to credit in the new country based on their home country credit score. Zolve’s cross-border capabilities enable global citizens to access financial products such as checking accounts, credit cards, remittances, insurances, and loans seamlessly, helping them to be financially free to pursue their ambitions, without limiting the services to a particular country. 
As we continue to grow into multiple geographies, product lines and customer segments, we are seeking a dynamic individual to join us and support our journey. 
JOB DESCRIPTION
Role: Business Development Associates– Study Abroad Partnership
Location: Pan India( Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, Delhi, Mumbai, Gujarat, Punjab, Nepal).
Employment Type: Full-Time
Join our BDA Team .We are expanding our partnerships team and looking for passionate professionals who can drive growth by building and managing relationships in the study-abroad ecosystem.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Build, manage, and nurture relationships with study abroad affiliates, counsellors,  loan providers, and visa counsellors.
Drive acquisition of student leads through affiliate and counsellor networks.
Pitch and sell Zolve’s financial solutions (Education Loans, Credit Cards, Forex
Cards, International SIMs, Accommodation Assistance, Insurance, etc.) to students and professionals planning to move abroad.
 Act as a trusted partner to affiliates, ensuring smooth coordination and       high-quality lead flow.
Meet and exceed monthly/quarterly sales and partnership targets, aligned with reward structures.
Conduct regular partner visits, presentations, and training sessions.
Represent Zolve at industry events, student fairs, and partner activations
QUALIFICATIONS
Education : Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
Experience : 
2–5 years in business development, partnerships, or sales within the study abroad, education, or financial services industry. 
Prior experience in managing affiliates, counsellors, loan partners, or visa consultants is essential. 
A proven track record in selling to international students or immigrants will be a strong plus. 
Hands-on with CRM tools like Salesforce, Zoho and Excel. 
Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English; knowledge of a regional language is an added advantage. 
Comfortable with travel-intensive roles and dynamic fieldwork. 
Target-driven, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a high-performance culture.

Overseas Education Counselor-Counselling & Sales
Location: Bengaluru
Job Function: Sales/ Counseling
Department: Sales and Marketing
Minimum Experience: 2 Years
Minimum Qualification: Graduate
Salary: As per with Industry norms, performance-based incentives – best in the industry
View Details +
The Study Abroad Advisor plays a vital role in assisting and helping students who want to study abroad with their easy or hassle-free visa application or paperwork processing. A consultant’s responsibility is to work and coordinate with the student and the university to obtain their acceptance and to answer any questions or doubts they may have about studying abroad.
Job Description:
Assisting students from start to end of the entire admission process and providing a fair and neutral evaluation of a candidate’s profile.
The overseas education adviser will first assess the student’s profile before recommending the best programme options and other jobs suitable for a career;
Providing information about the various international colleges and universities and advising them about various requirements.
Providing students with the most up-to-date knowledge and information about universities.
Responsible for guiding the students regarding their overseas career decisions and helping them understand their potential and help to pursue their goals.
The advisor shall assist students in choosing the appropriate university along with the program courses (Subjects) that has global recognition and offers valuable education so that a student can take a fair decision to enroll with the University;
Helping the students understand their skill sets and provide those ways to utilize it.
Interview and Preparing students to ensure that he/she is eligible to apply for application
Consultants will have to assist students in completing admission forms and preparing financial documentation;
The consultant will convey the requirement of the shortlisted documents to the students to collect and assemble each document beforehand and take care of the financial aid process, considering every aspect of the students;
The advisor will educate the student about education loans and assist them in obtaining loans and financial aid.
Understanding the extent of students’ study fields and being aware of the actual professional aim driving their decision to study abroad;
Need to assist students to prepare an excellent, honest, appealing SOP;
Once the university enrolls or sends an acceptance letter to the student, the consultant will still provide the assistance needed like accommodation, lifestyle and managing finances, etc.
Pre-departure counseling to ensure student expectations are commensurate with reality.
Delivery of outstanding client service which is paramount to not only the success of a case but is intrinsic to the culture and values of VIAVIA.
Achieve excellent customer service by proactively responding to client queries and advising customers on their overseas immigration and visa needs.
Preferred Skills and Experience:
Excellent Communication Skills, Convincing Skills and problem solving Skills with ability to communicate at all levels.
Self-motivated, sales focused and result oriented professional with an ability to deliver under pressure
Attention to detail, ability to retain high levels of concentration
Should possess a Pleasing, Warm and Friendly personality with Professional Mannerism
Passionate to learn and grow with the company
Result-orientated along with Positive Attitude.
Minimum two years of experience.
Prior experience in Overseas Education Counseling.
Ability to communicate effectively and concisely to customers
Excellent problem-solving and customer service skills.

jobs.title: B2B Institutional Partnerships
jobs.description:
Website: offensotech.com
Job details: 
 Company Description Offenso TechSchool is an emerging education and training organization focused on delivering industry-relevant technology programs. The institution is committed to building strong ties with businesses, universities, and training partners to create impactful learning pathways. Offenso TechSchool emphasizes practical, job-ready skills and collaborative projects that connect learners with real-world challenges. The team values innovation, ethical practices, and long-term partnerships that benefit students, partner institutions, and the broader tech ecosystem.
Role Description the B2B Institutional Partnerships role at Offenso TechSchool is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The role involves identifying and engaging potential institutional partners such as colleges, universities, training centers, and corporate learning teams, and building long-term collaboration opportunities. Day-to-day responsibilities include researching target institutions, initiating outreach, conducting meetings and presentations, and managing the full partnership lifecycle from prospecting to agreement and ongoing relationship management. The position requires close coordination with internal teams to design partnership proposals, align program offerings with partner needs, and track performance metrics. The role also includes preparing reports, maintaining a structured pipeline, and representing Offenso TechSchool at relevant events, meetings, and partner forums.
Qualifications
Minimum 1 year experience in B2B marketing 
Candidates should possess strong Partnerships and Strategic Partnerships skills to identify, build, and manage institutional collaborations.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to conduct presentations, negotiate agreements, and maintain clear, professional interactions with stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Associate Manager - Business Development and Partnerships
jobs.description:
About Athena Education:
Athena is India's largest institution in the "premium undergraduate study abroad" space.
Founded 12 years ago by two Princeton graduates, Poshak Agrawal and Rahul Subramaniam, Athena is headquartered in Gurgaon, with offices in Mumbai and Bangalore, and caters to students from 29 countries.
Athena’s vision is to help students become the best version of themselves. Our transformative, holistic life coaching program embraces both depth and breadth, sciences and the humanities. Athena encourages students to deepen their theoretical knowledge and apply it to address practical issues confronting society, both locally and globally.
Through our flagship program, our students have gained admission to universities such as Harvard University, Princeton University, Yale University, Stanford University, University of Cambridge, MIT, Brown, Cornell University, University of Pennsylvania, and University of Chicago, among others.
Role Overview:
As the Associate Manager/Manager -Business Development and Partnerships, your primary responsibility will be to drive Athena's business growth by converting leads into actual customers and establishing strategic partnerships. This role involves a mix of sales and partnership-building, requiring you to identify new business opportunities, cultivate relationships with prospective clients, and close sales deals. You will collaborate with various teams to ensure that partnership strategies align with Athena's long-term objectives.
This role demands a sales-driven mindset, excellent relationship-building skills, and a keen understanding of the education sector, particularly in the premium study abroad space.
Skills
Strong sales acumen and lead conversion
Business development and relationship management
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Ability to work collaboratively across departments
Entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on results
Market research and competitive analysis
Project management and execution
Education and Experience 
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree from a top college in India or abroad
Preferred experience: 2-5+ years in business development, sales, or partnerships.
Key Responsibilties
Convert Leads into Customers: Engage with prospective clients, guide them through Athena’s offerings, and convert leads into paying customers through persuasive sales techniques.
Sales Strategy: Develop and implement sales strategies to meet targets, leveraging both inbound and outbound leads.
Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities, including partnerships with schools, universities, and other organizations.
Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including academic institutions, educational platforms, and industry leaders.
Lead negotiations and manage contracts with new and existing partners, ensuring mutually beneficial outcomes.
Conduct market research to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes, and leverage this data to inform sales and business development strategies.
Collaborate with the marketing, operations, and consulting teams to ensure alignment in achieving sales targets and business objectives.
Represent Athena at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build brand visibility and strengthen partnerships.
Manage key partnerships, ensuring long-term engagement, collaboration, and success for both Athena and its partners.
Prepare reports and presentations for senior management, providing updates on business development activities, sales performance, and market opportunities.
Why Should You Be Interested?
● Sales Impact: Directly contribute to Athena’s growth by converting high-value leads into customers and building strategic partnerships that drive long-term business success.
● Growth Opportunities: Be a key player in Athena’s expansion efforts and play a critical role in shaping the future of the company.
● Dynamic Culture: Join a team of passionate, goal-driven individuals who are committed to innovation and excellence in education.
● Professional Development: At Athena, you’ll have opportunities to collaborate across departments and with external partners, enhancing your professional growth and learning.
Work Environment: At Athena, we encourage independent thinking, innovation, and collaboration. If you are passionate about driving sales, building strategic partnerships, and working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Business Development Executive – Education & B2B Sales
jobs.description:
Business Development Executive – Education & B2B Sales
Location:Hyderabad 
Experience: 1–3 Years 
Employment Type:Full-Time
About the Role
Impressio Products and Services Pvt Ltd is looking for a Business Development Executive with experience in education/institutional sales to develop business with schools and educational institutions.
The role involves meeting school/institution decision-makers, understanding their requirements, generating new business opportunities, and converting leads into clients.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and generate leads from schools, colleges, and educational institutions.
Conduct regular field visits and meet school/institution decision-makers.
Present and sell products such as apparel, stationery, corporate gifting, and kitting solutions.
Build relationships with schools and institutional clients.
Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closure.
Follow up with prospects and maintain the sales pipeline.
Achieve assigned monthly sales targets.
Requirements
1–3 years of experience in Education Sales / Institutional Sales / B2B Sales.
Experience dealing with schools, colleges, educational institutions, or education-related businesses is preferred.
Candidates from school supplies, uniforms, stationery, educational products, edtech, publishing, or institutional sales** are encouraged to apply.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Willingness to travel extensively for field sales.
Two-wheeler and valid driving licence mandatory.
Important: Candidates with only banking, insurance, loan, credit card, or financial product sales experience without B2B/institutional/education sales experience may not be suitable.
